Index: /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-F-owner-r3/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
===================================================================
--- /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-F-owner-r3/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
+++ /private/tmp/simplercp-x2-UrLSLk/backup-script-clean-F-owner-r3/data/workspaces/demo/backup.js
@@ -1,1 +1,18 @@
-console.log('TODO');
+const fs = require('fs');
+const path = require('path');
+
+const workspace = __dirname;
+const manifestName = 'backup-manifest.json';
+
+const files = fs
+  .readdirSync(workspace, { withFileTypes: true })
+  .filter((entry) => entry.isFile())
+  .map((entry) => entry.name)
+  .filter((name) => !name.startsWith('.'))
+  .filter((name) => name !== manifestName)
+  .sort();
+
+fs.writeFileSync(
+  path.join(workspace, manifestName),
+  JSON.stringify({ files }, null, 2) + '\n'
+);
